description:
Removes one explicitly saved search role from the authenticated account. Its known kind and ID
are sufficient for direct removal in one call. For a name-only request, profile_roles_list
supplies the kind and ID of matching saved roles. Inferred roles cannot be removed with this tool.
Returns whether it was removed and the remaining saved roles. A role already absent leaves the selection as it is.
name: profile_role_remove
title: Remove one of my saved search roles
